# Beerenberg

> > Beerenberg is a 47-year-old maintenance and modification partner specializing in isolation, scaffolding, surface treatment, and robotized solutions across energy, offshore, industrial, and infrastructure sectors.

Beerenberg operates across Norway, Sweden, Poland, and Brazil, providing comprehensive maintenance and modification services to the energy, industrial, transport, and construction sectors. The company combines traditional expertise with modern robotization and sustainability-focused solutions.

## Key Topics

- Maintenance Services
- Scaffolding
- Surface Treatment
- Isolation & Fire Protection
- Offshore Operations
- Energy Sector
- Infrastructure Maintenance
- Robotized Services
- Oil & Gas Industry
- Industrial Services

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Our Services](https://beerenberg.com/tjenester): Main services: isolation, scaffolding, surface treatment with 47 years of industry experience
- [Benarx Products](https://beerenberg.com/produkter): Benarx insulation and fire protection products: thermal, acoustic, and corrosion solutions
- [Homepage](https://beerenberg.com): Beerenberg: your partner for maintenance and modification services in energy and industry
- [English Site](https://beerenberg.com/en): English homepage: sustainable maintenance and modification services

## Industry Solutions

- [Industry Sectors](https://beerenberg.com/bransjer): Maintenance and modification solutions for offshore, onshore, and transport sectors
- [Energy Sector](https://beerenberg.com/bransjer/energi): Energy industry services: oil and gas maintenance, robotization, and sustainability solutions
- [Transport Infrastructure](https://beerenberg.com/bransjer/samferdsel): Transport infrastructure maintenance: bridges, roads, and tunnels across Norway
- [Industrial Maintenance](https://beerenberg.com/bransjer/industri): Industrial solutions: surface treatment, insulation, and robotized services
- [Construction & Engineering](https://beerenberg.com/bransjer/bygg-og-anlegg): Construction services: scaffolding design, surface treatment, and mechanical work
- [Brazil Operations](https://beerenberg.com/br): Brazil partner: offshore maintenance and robotic solutions
